qa_pairs.question: What section number covers body repair procedures?
On which page can I find information about replacing the center door pillar for 4-door cars?
qa_pairs.answer: Information about replacing the center door pillar for 4-door cars can be found on page 41-201.

qa_pairs.question: What is the page reference for roof frame replacement procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: Roof frame replacement procedures are covered on pages 41-211 and 41-216, with 41-211 for roof panel removed procedures and 41-216 for front roof frame replacement with roof panel removed.

qa_pairs.question: Which page covers cowl panel replacement procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: Cowl panel replacement procedures are covered on page 41-304.

qa_pairs.question: What are the different door pillar replacement procedures listed in this section?
qa_pairs.answer: The door pillar replacement procedures include center door pillar replacement for left or right (4-door cars), center door pillar outer section replacement for left or right (4-door cars), and front door pillar replacement for left or right with front side panel removed.

qa_pairs.question: What prerequisite is mentioned for front door pillar replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: Front door pillar replacement requires the front side panel to be removed first.
